info.title: Dromo
info.description: Dromo's APIs provide convenient programmatic access to your uploads and schemas. You can use them to create powerful automated workflows.

get.description: Returns all saved import schemas available to the authenticated Dromo organization.

post.description: Creates a saved import schema with fields, settings, and optional hooks for reuse in Dromo imports.

get.description: Returns one saved import schema by ID, including its fields, settings, and hooks.

put.description: Replaces the fields, settings, and hooks of an existing saved import schema identified by ID.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a saved import schema identified by ID.

get.description: Lists completed Dromo uploads for the authenticated organization, optionally filtered by a start and end date.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: end index, defaults to max return value, 10000

get.description: Returns metadata for a completed Dromo upload, including information about its schema, user, and results.

post.description: Permanently deletes a completed upload and its stored data from Dromo.

get.summary: Get presigned download URL for upload data
get.description: Creates a temporary presigned URL for securely downloading the data from a completed upload.

200.description: Returns a signed URL to access the upload's data.

presigned_url.description: The presigned download URL to access the upload's data.

get.description: Returns the current status and available result or review information for a headless import by ID.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a headless import identified by ID.

get.summary: Get presigned download URL for headless import data
get.description: Creates a temporary presigned URL for downloading the processed data from a successful headless import.

200.description: Returns a signed URL to access the headless import's result data.

presigned_url.description: The presigned download URL to access the headless import's result data.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of headless imports for the authenticated Dromo organization.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: total number of imports to return, defaults 100 max 1000

post.description: Starts a headless import from an uploaded file or data payload using a saved or inline schema.

schema_id.description: ID of a saved schema. Mutually exclusive with `fields` — provide `schema_id` or `fields`, not both. When provided alongside `settings` or `hooks`, those values are merged on top of the saved schema for this import only.

oneOf.description: Name of the file being imported (exclude if using initial_data)
Complete JSON data to be imported, max size 15MB (exclude if using a file)

rowHooks: (record, mode) => { return { row: { first_name: { value: "Updated from row hook" } } }; }

404.description: No schema found with that id

get.description: Returns the SFTP credential configurations available to the authenticated Dromo organization.

post.description: Creates an SFTP credential configuration for connecting Dromo to an SFTP server.

detail.example: Must supply password for password auth

get.description: Returns one SFTP credential configuration by ID without exposing secret credential values.

put.description: Updates an existing SFTP credential configuration identified by ID.

delete.description: Deletes an SFTP credential configuration identified by ID.

post.description: Tests whether Dromo can connect to the SFTP server using the selected credential configuration.

get.description: Returns the automated SFTP import connectors configured for the authenticated Dromo organization.

post.description: Creates an automated SFTP connector that imports files using configured credentials and schema settings.

get.description: Returns one automated SFTP connector and its import configuration by ID.

put.description: Updates an existing automated SFTP connector identified by ID.

delete.description: Deletes an automated SFTP connector identified by ID.

SchemaFields.description: Inline schema field definitions. Required when `schema_id` is omitted; mutually exclusive with `schema_id`. Accepts the same field definitions as a saved schema.

selectOptions.description: Allowed values for select and multi-select fields. Required for those field types.

SchemaSettings.description: Import settings. When used with `schema_id`, merged on top of the saved schema (provided keys overwrite; omitted keys are unchanged). When used without `schema_id`, defines settings for the inline schema.

locale.description: Supported locale shorthand, such as en, es, fr, or zh_CN.

SchemaHooks.description: Import hooks. When used with `schema_id`, merged on top of the saved schema. When used without `schema_id`, defines hooks for the inline schema.

rowHooks: (record, mode) => { return { row: { first_name: { value: "Updated from row hook" } } }; }
